prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 27.3% higher than a year ago. Also in its favour: over the past year the share did 29.5 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; the share price is close to its 52-week high; and profit grew 58% compared with a year earlier. Other areas on this side: growth, what the price asks for the earnings, the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on price behaviour: the 3-year maximum drawdown was -48.7%, a deep fall. Also against it: one-year volatility is 41.6%, high; quality scores only 7 of 100 against the comparison pool; and growth scores only 18 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: the quality of the business, growth, risk.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 7 points in favour and 6 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 32 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Hold with medium confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
